plain.li: [greetings,warm,house:renowned] We know your family's name here, {WRITER}. A letter from {HOUSE} is read twice.
[greetings,cordial,house:renowned,theirLowtech] The name of {HOUSE} has reached our hall. It is good to have a letter from one of them.
[greetings,cordial,house:renowned,theirHightech] Your family's name is known here, {WRITER}. Good to hear from {HOUSE} directly.
[greetings,cool,house:renowned] We have your letter. Your family's name is known here, and that is about all we know of you.
[greetings,warm,house:wide] Your family's name is {RENOWN}, {WRITER}. We are glad it has written to us.
[greetings,cordial,house:known,!house:renowned] We have heard of {HOUSE} a little. It is good to put a face to the name, or at least a hand.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:healers] We hear your family is known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. Our sick are glad of such neighbors.
[greetings,warm,house:knownfor:hosts] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR}, and your letter reads like it.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:fighters,theirLowtech] Our fighters speak of your family, known for {KNOWNFOR} as it is. They would rather have it beside them than against them.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:traders,theirHightech] Your family's known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. We'll read your letters with care.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:makers] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR} here. If you ever have work to spare, our traders will want to see it.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:faithful,theirLowtech] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR} even here. May your faith keep you as you keep it.
[help,warm,house:renowned] For one of {HOUSE}, we send {HELP} gladly.
[help,cordial,house:knownfor:healers] We can spare some {HELP}. A family known for {KNOWNFOR} will use it well.
[invitation,warm,house:renowned] An invitation from one of {HOUSE} is not one to turn down. We will come.
[news,cordial,house:renowned] Here is our news, and you may like to know your family's name is {RENOWN}.
[condolences,warm,house:renowned] A loss to {HOUSE} is felt here too. Your family's name is honored among us.
[greetings,cool,house:infamous] We have your letter. Your family's name is not one we are glad to see on it.
[greetings,curt,house:infamous] Your letter came. So did what is said of {HOUSE}.
[help,refusal,house:infamous] Your family's name does you no favors here. We will not send {HELP}.
[invitation,cool,house:infamous] We have read your invitation. With what is said of {HOUSE}, we will stay home.
[greetings,cordial,them:house:renowned,theirLowtech] Our house thanks you for writing. Its name is old here, and we are glad yours knows it.
[greetings,cool,them:house:feud] We have your letter. There is still a grudge between our house and your colony, and a letter does not settle it.
[greetings,curt,them:house:feud,theirLowtech] Our house has not forgotten what lies between us. Write if you must.
[renownup,us] They say our family's name is known well beyond the colony now.
[renownup,us] Funny to think strangers know our name.
[renownup,us,tribal] The other camps tell of our family at their fires now, I hear.
[renownup,us,tribal] Our name has walked further than any of us have.
[renownup,us,medieval] I hear there's a song with our name in it now.
[renownup,us,medieval] Our family's name gets a nod in the markets now, I'm told.
[renownup,us,industrial] Somebody said our name made the papers, of all things.
[renownup,us,industrial] Our family's getting a reputation out there.
[renownup,us,spacer] Our name's turning up on channels I've never heard of.
[renownup,us,spacer] Seems our family name carries further than our transmitter does.
[renownup,us,kind] I just hope the name stays a good one.
[renowndown,us] Seems people out there have stopped talking about us.
[renowndown,us] Our name doesn't go as far as it did.
[renowndown,us,tribal] The fires have other stories to tell now.
[renowndown,us,medieval] The singers have found someone else to sing about.
[renowndown,us,industrial] We're old news now, apparently.
[renowndown,us,spacer] Our name has dropped off the channels.
[wordyes,them,house:renowned] With a name like your family's, the good word half speaks itself.
[wordyes,them,house:renowned,theirLowtech] Your family's name opens doors at home, I'll put in my word too.
[wordyes,them,house:renowned,theirHightech] A good word for a known name is an easy word to give.
